Batch 55 is authored and all nine Step 1 records are `ready`; their hashes revalidate against the current items and dependencies. This is authoring readiness, not independent approval.

The added choice-free interval lemma establishes the standard-Borel prerequisite for the PRDS definition. The BY proof uses CDF summation by parts to preserve the arbitrary-dependence guarantee for discrete superuniform p-values. The proof-route correction is documented for owner reconciliation.

Scoped checks passed for dependency levels, dependency closure, forward and external references, strict proof contracts, precheck, proof layout, rendering, and page/manifest consistency. Source retrieval resolved 4/4 records: 3 fetch stamps and one documented BY01 endpoint drop. Coverage review reports one low-yield warning: 5 of 14 harvested results became standalone items; the rest have inline dispositions and reasons for reviewer review.

Key evidence: [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/statistical-models-experiments-62-batch-55.notes.md), [cross-batch dependencies](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/statistical-models-experiments-62-batch-55.cross-batch-dependencies.json), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/statistical-models-experiments-62-batch-55.proof-contracts.json), and [source coverage](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/statistical-models-experiments-62-batch-55.coverage.json). The added standard-Borel lemma is in [lem-unit-interval-is-standard-borel.md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/lem-unit-interval-is-standard-borel.md); its lecture-note cross-check is [Marker’s *Descriptive Set Theory*](https://www.math.uic.edu/~marker/math512/dst.pdf).
